newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada spot natgas prices held down on AECO work.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas prices held down on AECO work.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices for September remained pressured in Wednesday trade by maintenance work at the industry's main price-setting hub, marketing sources said.
Gas for September delivery at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was talked in the C$0.93/0.94 per gigajoule range, down from C$1.12/1.125 last week. October gas was talked at C$1.15/1.16 per GJ.
Prices were hammered on Monday, falling to as low as C$0.82 per GJ as work began at AECO. Full service was expected to be returned to injection customers on September 16.

Traders said the lack of injection capacity was wreaking havoc on the market. One Calgary-based marketer said normal injections into the three Alberta facilities would be about 750 million cubic feet per day. But only about 440 million was being taken in.
"(The price is) totally AECO-dependent," he said. "It's all gas-on-gas competition right now."
At the borders, gas at Niagara, Dawn and Parkway was talked in the low US$2 per million British thermal units range.
One trader of eastern gas said prices were expected to remain in the current range assuming normal weather conditions. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
